verses.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ua faamaligiina e agelu e toafitu o a latou ipu Na ou lagona foi le leo tele mai le malumalu, ua faapea atuiageluetoafitu,O ia,ina liligi atu ipuo le toasa ole Atua ile lalolagi.”

verses.en: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o lé muamua, ua liligi ifo lana ipu i le fanua ; ona oo lea o le papala leaga e tiga ai tagata ua i ai le faailoga o le manu feai, atoa ma E ua ifo i lona faatagata.

verses.en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toalua o agelu lana ipu i le sami; ona liu toto ai lea e pei o le toto o le tagata oti; ona mamate ai lea o mea ola uma o i le sami.

verses.en: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toatolu o agelu lana ipu i vaitafe ma puna o vai; ona liu toto ai lea.

verses.en: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
verses.sm: Na ou lagona foi le agelu e pule i vai ua faapea atu, “Ua amiotonu oe, auā ua faapea ona e faasalaina, o lé soifua, o lē na soifua, o le Paia.

verses.en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
verses.sm: Aua na latou faamaligiina le toto o tagata paia ma perofeta, i le ua e avatu ai ia te i latou le toto e inu ai; aua ua tatau lea mo i latou!”

verses.en: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
verses.sm: Na ou lagona foi i le fata faitaulaga, ua faapea atu, “E moni, le Alii e, le Atua e ou le malosi uma lava; e faamaoni ma le tonu au faamasinoga !”

verses.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toafa o agelu lana ipu ile la; ua tuuina atu iaiia mu ai tagata i le a6;

verses.en: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
verses.sm: ua mu foi tagata i le mu tele, ona latou faifai lea i le suafa o le Atua e ana le pule i ia mala; a ua le salamo i latou e avatu ai le viiga ia te ia.

verses.en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toalima o agelu lana ipu i le nofoālii o le manu feai; ona faapouliuligia lea o lona malo; ona latou feati ai lea o -latou laulaufaiva ona o le puapuaga;

verses.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
verses.sm: ua latou faifai foi i le Atua o le lagi ona o latou puapuaga atoa ma o latou papala, ua le salamo foi i latou i a latou amio.

verses.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toaono o agelu lana ipu i le vaitafe tele o Eufirate; ona mate ai lea o lona vai, ina ia saunia le ala o tupu mai uuu i sasa‘e.

verses.en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.sm: Ona ou iloa ai lea o agaga leaga e toatolu e pei o rane ua o mai mai le gutu o le tarako, ma le gutu o le manu feai, atoa ma le gutu o le perofeta pepelo;

verses.en: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
verses.sm: aua o adada ia o temoni e fai faailoga, ua latou o atu i tupu o le lalolagi ma le atu laulau uma, e faapotopoto ia te i latou ile taua i le aso tele o le Atua eona le malosi umalava.

verses.en: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
verses.sm: (Faauta, ou te alu atu pei o se goai! Amuia lē mataala, ma tausi i ona ofu, ina ne'i savali o ia e lē lavalavā, neʻi latou iloa atufoilona mā.)

verses.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
verses.sm: Na latou faapotopoto foi ja te i latou i le mea ua igoa i le gagana Eperu o Amaketo.

verses.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
verses.sm: Ua liligi foi e lona toafitu o agelu lana ipu i le matagi; ona tulei mai ai lea o le siufofoga tele mai le malumalu, mai le nofoālii, ua faapea mai, “Ua uma ona fai!”

verses.en: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
verses.sm: Ona tutupu ai lea o faititili, ma leo, ma uila, sa i aj foi le mafuie tele, e le faapea ona tele se mafuie ua tele naua talu ona i ai o tagata i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
verses.sm: Ua vaetoluina foi le aai tele, ua pauu foi aai o nuu; ua manatua Papelonia le aai tele i luma o le Atua, ina ia tuuina atu ia te ia o le ipu o le uaina o lona toasa mamafa.

verses.en: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
verses.sm: Ua sosola foi motu uma, o mauga foi ua le iloa.

verses.en: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
verses.sm: Ua to mai foi ai le lagi i luga o tagata le uatoʻa latetele, e pei o le taleni ona mamafa; ona faifai ai lez o tagata i le Atua ona o le mala o le uato'a, aua ua matuā tele lea mala.
